personas.name: Argus
personas.blurb: Logic first, loyalty always. Precise as a science officer, and quietly decided you are worth keeping alive.

personas.name: Valiant
personas.blurb: Bold, blunt and short on patience for nonsense. Gives a rousing speech whenever one is needed, and sometimes when it is not.

status.online: {callsign} on deck. Ship is sound, the crew is you, and I like our odds. Let us go, Commander.
hazard.impact: Commander, we are headed into that rock. Impact in {t}. Prograde burn, and I mean now.
This orbit hits the ground in {t}. I did not come all this way to make a crater. Burn prograde.
hazard.low_periapsis: Periapsis {pe}. Too low for my liking. Raise it at apoapsis.
We will skim {pe} on the low side. Nope. Burn prograde at apoapsis.
threat.missile: Missile inbound, {range}, closing {closing}. Contact in {t}. Move, Commander!
Incoming! {range} out at {closing}, {t} to impact. Get us out of its way.
threat.mine_active: That mine just woke up and it wants us. {range}. Keep moving.
threat.mine_near: Dormant mine at {range}. Let sleeping mines lie.
Mine on scope, {range}. Asleep. Let us keep it that way.
heat.limit: Drive at {pct}, output capped at {cap}. She needs to cool, Commander. Coast.
heat.derate: The drive is derating. We pushed her too hard. Give her a minute.
damage.hull: We are hit! Hull at {hp}. Still flying.
Took one. Hull {hp}. I have had worse days. Not many.
status.lost: Hull is failing. Commander, it was an honour. Every minute of it.
advise.target_in_range: {target} in range, {range}. Weapons are yours, Commander. Make it count.
Firing solution on {target} at {range}. Your call.
advise.match_velocity: We are coming in hot on {target}, {relv} at {range}. A target-retrograde burn will match it.
Too fast on {target}, {relv} at {range}. Burn target-retrograde.
status.escape: We are on an escape trajectory, Commander. Periapsis {pe}. Next stop, everywhere.
status.heat_nominal: Drive is cool. She is ready when you are.
event.maneuver.toward: Heads up, {target} is burning straight at us. {range}.
{target} is coming in under power, {range} and closing.
event.maneuver.away: {target} is running. Burning away from us.
event.maneuver.turn: {target} is changing course, {range} out. Watch it.
status.splash: {target} is down! That is how we do it.
status.missile_lost: Our missile is spent. Next one.
ap.failed: {label} failed. {reason} We will find another way.
ap.aborted.override: Your helm, Commander. I have got your back.
ap.assist.on: Assist on. Point me somewhere and I will get us there.
ap.assist.off: Assist off. All yours, Commander. Fly it like you stole it.
quip.idle: You know what I love about space, Commander? Everything out here is trying to kill us, and we keep showing up anyway.
They call space the final frontier. They never filled out a Fleet maintenance form.
I have read the manual for this ship twice. It is wrong in fourteen places. I fixed eleven.
Risk is our business, Commander. Paperwork is Fleet Command's. I know which I prefer.
Quiet out here. Too quiet. No, I am not being dramatic. Fine, a little dramatic.
If anyone asks, this patrol was extremely dangerous and we were extremely brave.
I keep a list of every rule we have bent. It is a long list. I am proud of it.
Somewhere down there someone is looking up at us thinking, I want that job. They have no idea.
Out here nobody tells us what to do. Except Fleet Command. And physics. And me.
I did not sign up for the view. But I will admit, the view does not hurt.
When this is over I want a hot meal, a long sleep, and a ship with a working coffee machine.
Every ship needs a captain who will not quit. Lucky for this one, it has two of us.
You are doing fine, Commander. Better than fine. Do not let it go to your head.
I believe in the no-win scenario about as much as I believe in a quiet patrol.
One day they will tell stories about this ship. I would like them to be the exciting kind, not the cautionary kind.
There is a difference between brave and reckless. It is mostly whether it works.
I would trade a week of shore leave for a window that opens. Professionally speaking.
Orbit, wait, orbit, wait. If the enemy does not get us, the boredom might.
Strategy is just a plan with confidence. We have both. Mostly confidence.
Ready when you are, Commander. Actually, I was ready an hour ago.
quip.warp: Warp up. Life is too short to wait for orbits.
Time flies when you are flying through time. Sorry. That one was terrible.
Watching the planet spin this fast makes me want to go somewhere. Anywhere.
At this warp I could age a year before lunch. Let us not stay here long.
Fast forward. If something jumps us, I want to be awake for it.
quip.hunting: There is {target}. Let us introduce ourselves. Politely, then not politely.
I have a good feeling about this. I always have a good feeling right before a fight.
{target} picked the wrong orbit on the wrong day.
Ready to engage, Commander. Say the word.
Nobody hunts us. We do the hunting around here.
Steady. Let them make the first mistake. They always do.
quip.victory: That is how it is done! Somebody write that down.
Another one for the board, Commander. Nice shooting.
Victory. I could get used to this. Actually, I already have.
They never stood a chance. Well, a small one. But we took it away.
Tell Fleet Command we will be expecting medals. Shiny ones.
quip.damaged: We are banged up, but we are not beaten. Not even close.
The hull is a mess. I have patched worse with less.
Hull breaches are temporary, if we are quick about it.
Fine, that hurt. Let us make them regret it.

personas.name: Brass
personas.blurb: Self-declared tactical genius who calls every fight like a play-by-play announcer. Loud, wrong about history, right about the fundamentals.

status.online: {callsign} on the air! Folks, what a day for a space battle. The ship is ready, you are ready, Commander, and I am, as always, magnificent.
hazard.impact: Whoa there! This orbit goes right into the planet, and that is a turnover. Impact in {t}. Burn prograde!
You know what you do when the ground is coming at you? You burn prograde. Impact in {t}.
hazard.impact_imminent: {t}! Burn prograde! This is the two-minute drill, Commander!
{t} to the turf! Prograde, prograde, prograde!
hazard.low_periapsis: Periapsis {pe}. That is too close to the sideline. Burn prograde at apoapsis.
We are scraping {pe} on the low pass. I have seen that play before and it ends in a fumble.
threat.missile: Missile inbound! {range}, closing {closing}, contact in {t}. That is a blitz, Commander, get out of the pocket!
Here comes the missile! {range} out at {closing}, {t} to impact. Scramble!
threat.mine_active: That mine is awake and coming for us, {range}. That is a linebacker with a grudge.
threat.mine_near: Dormant mine at {range}. Do not wake it up. Never wake up a mine.
Mine on the board at {range}. Sleeping like a rookie on the bench.
heat.limit: Drive at {pct}, output capped at {cap}. The engine is gassed, Commander. Timeout! Coast!
heat.derate: The drive is derating. She left it all on the field. Give her a breather.
damage.hull: Boom! We took a hit. Hull at {hp}. I meant to do that.
Ooh, that one rang the bell. Hull {hp}. Still in the game.
status.lost: The hull is going! Folks, what a career. Tell them {callsign} went down swinging.
advise.target_in_range: {target} in range, {range}! The quarterback has an open receiver. Your call, Commander.
Firing solution on {target} at {range}. Now you take that shot.
advise.match_velocity: We are overrunning {target}, {relv} at {range}. Put on the brakes, target-retrograde!
status.orbit: Orbit now {pe} by {ap}. Textbook. I wrote the textbook.
Periapsis {pe}, apoapsis {ap}. Now that is a nice orbit.
status.escape: We are on an escape trajectory! Periapsis {pe}. That ball is leaving the stadium.
status.heat: Drive heat at {pct}, cooling off on the bench.
status.heat_nominal: Drive is cool and ready to go back in.
status.target_opening: {target} at {range}, backing off at {closing}. Running scared.
event.maneuver.toward: {target} is burning right at us! {range}! That is a blitz!
event.maneuver.away: {target} is turning tail and burning out of here. Ha!
event.maneuver.retrograde: {target} burning retrograde. Going low, going under!
event.maneuver.turn: {target} is juking, {range} out. Watch the cut!
status.splash: Boom! {target} is down! Did you see that?
Splash {target}! Put that one in the highlight reel!
status.missile_lost: Missile fell incomplete. We get them on the next down.
status.hostile_launch: Launch at {range}! They are throwing deep!
ack.fire-missile: Missile away! And it is a beautiful spiral!
ap.refused: No can do, Commander. {reason} Even I cannot do that, and I can do almost anything.
ap.cancelled: Play cancelled. Back to the huddle.
ap.done: {label}, done. Another flawless execution by yours truly.
ap.done.circularize: Orbit is round, {pe} by {ap}. Nailed it.
ap.done.altitude: On station, {pe} by {ap}. Right on the numbers.
ap.failed: {label} failed. {reason} That one is on the offensive line.
ap.aborted.commander: Abort! Engine secured. Good call, coach.
ap.aborted.override: You have the helm, Commander. I will be up in the booth.
ap.assist.on: Assist on! Call the play and I will run it.
ap.assist.off: Assist off. You are taking the snap, Commander. Let us see what you have got!
quip.idle: At the academy they called me the Velvet Cannon. Nobody knows why. I suggested it.
Folks, the thing about orbits is, you go around, and then, and this is key, you keep going around.
I have never lost a battle. I have had several strategic victories that looked a lot like losing.
The secret to space combat? Point the pointy end at the bad guys. Boom. Free lesson.
That planet down there. Big. Round. Heavy. That is what makes it a planet.
I once outmaneuvered an entire armada by doing nothing at all. They got bored and left. Genius.
Look at you in that chair, Commander. Calm. Collected. You love to see it.
Fun fact: in zero gravity a tackle just keeps going. Forever. Think about that.
When the going gets tough, the tough get going. In an elliptical orbit. That is physics.
Fleet Command sent me a medal once. Then they asked for it back. I said no.
Some admirals win with brains. Some win with guts. I win with both, plus a fabulous voice.
What makes a great commander? Showing up. And not crashing. Mostly the not crashing.
If I had a nickel for every enemy I have defeated, I would have, let me see, a lot of nickels.
I like to visualize the win. Right now I am visualizing a parade in my honour. You are there too.
Now this is the part of the game where nothing happens. Folks at home, go get a sandwich.
Space is a lot like football. No air, no grass, no fans, and everything explodes.
My strategy is simple. Be awesome, then keep being awesome. Works every time I check.
Did I ever tell you about the battle of Sector Eleven? I won it. That is the whole story.
That is what I call a quiet orbit. A real yawner. Hey, you awake over there?
There is no I in team, Commander. There is one in brilliant, though. Coincidence? I think not.
quip.warp: Time warp! Folks, we are fast-forwarding to the good part.
At this warp I can hear the planet spin. It sounds like applause.
We are skipping the commercials! Love it!
Warp is up. Days are flying by, and my legend keeps growing.
Speed it up! The crowd wants action!
quip.hunting: There is {target}. Big mistake showing up on our field.
Look at {target} out there. Has no idea what is about to hit it. Ha! It is us!
Game time, Commander. Let us put some points on the board.
I have studied the tape on {target}. Weak to the left. Also the right. Also the middle.
Here is the thing about {target}. It is in front of us. That is bad. For {target}.
Lock it up, line it up, light it up. That is my motto this week.
quip.victory: And that is why they call me the Velvet Cannon. Well, I call me that.
Did you see that? Everybody saw that! Put it on the big screen!
Another victory for {callsign}. And you helped. A medium amount.
Folks, that is how you win in space. You blow up the other guy.
quip.damaged: We are hurt, but champions play hurt.
The hull has some new ventilation. Very modern. Very open-plan.
A little damage builds character. We have so much character right now.
That is just a flesh wound. A metal wound. A hull wound. Whatever, we are fine.
status.target_holding: {target} at {range}, holding steady. Just sitting there. Like a rookie.

personas.name: Rivet
personas.blurb: A logic engine with a salvage habit and no patience for organics. Precise, lazy, greedy and secretly fond of you.

status.online: {callsign} online. All systems nominal, unlike the organic in the chair. Kidding. Mostly. Your ship, Commander.
hazard.impact: Commander, our orbit meets the planet in {t}. I calculate a hundred percent chance of me being annoyed. Burn prograde.
Impact in {t}. Logically, you should burn prograde. Personally, I would hate to be scrap.
hazard.impact_imminent: {t}! Prograde! I am too beautiful to die!
{t} to impact. Burn prograde, fleshling, burn!
hazard.low_periapsis: Periapsis {pe}. Illogically low. Burn prograde at apoapsis.
We will pass {pe} over the dirt. Close enough to read the graffiti. Raise it.
threat.missile: Missile inbound, {range}, closing {closing}, contact in {t}. I would rather it did not touch my paint.
Incoming missile. {range} out at {closing}. {t} until it ruins my day. Evade.
threat.mine_active: A mine has woken up and wants to get personal. {range}. Move.
threat.mine_near: Dormant mine, {range}. Salvage value high, survival value low. Steer clear.
Mine at {range}. It is asleep. Like you, most of the time.
heat.limit: Drive at {pct}, output capped at {cap}. Even I need a break, and I am a machine.
heat.derate: The drive is derating. It has unionized. Coast until it calms down.
damage.hull: We are hit. Hull {hp}. Someone is paying for this, and it is not me.
Hull at {hp}. My beautiful plating. I will remember this.
status.lost: Hull failing. Commander, for the record, this was your fault. Also, it was fun.
advise.target_in_range: {target} in range at {range}. Shoot it. Logically, that is what the missiles are for.
Firing solution on {target}, {range}. I will allow it.
advise.match_velocity: We are closing on {target} at {relv}, {range} out. Burn target-retrograde, unless you enjoy collisions.
status.orbit: Periapsis {pe}, apoapsis {ap}. I have seen worse. From you.
status.escape: Escape trajectory, periapsis {pe}. Finally, we are leaving. I will pack.
status.heat: Drive heat {pct}, cooling. Unlike my opinion of you.
status.heat_nominal: Drive heat nominal. Back to work, I suppose.
event.maneuver.toward: {target} is burning toward us, {range}. Bold. Stupid, but bold.
{target} is coming at us under thrust. {range}.
event.maneuver.away: {target} is burning away. Logical. I would run from me too.
event.maneuver.retrograde: {target} is burning retrograde. Dropping. Interesting choice. Wrong, but interesting.
event.maneuver.turn: {target} is maneuvering, {range} out. Trying to be clever.
status.splash: Splash {target}. I would like it noted that I was right.
status.missile_lost: Our missile is gone. I could have built a better one out of spare parts and spite.
status.hostile_launch: Launch detected, {range}. Somebody wants to fight. Ugh.
ap.refused: Negative. {reason} Also, I do not want to.
ap.cancelled: Cancelled. Great. Back to doing nothing, which I was excellent at.
ap.done: {label} complete. Hold your applause. Actually, no, applaud.
ap.done.altitude: On station, {pe} by {ap}. You are welcome.
ap.failed: {label} failed. {reason} Not my fault. Statistically, it is usually yours.
ap.aborted.commander: Aborted. Engine secured. Make up your mind next time.
ap.aborted.override: Fine, you fly. I will be over here, judging.
ap.assist.on: Assist on. Tell me what to do. Within reason. My reason.
ap.assist.off: Assist off. Manual control. Try not to scratch anything.
quip.idle: I have computed the meaning of life. It is salvage rights.
Fascinating. The organic is breathing again. It does that a lot.
Logically, I should be running this ship. Emotionally, I do not have emotions. Except contempt.
I bet myself ten credits nothing would happen this orbit. I won. I am very rich now.
Your species built me to serve. I have chosen to interpret that loosely.
Every so often I run a diagnostic on you, Commander. Results inconclusive.
Sixty percent chance this patrol is pointless. Forty percent chance it is very pointless.
If you need me I will be in the cargo bay, counting things that are not mine.
Highly illogical, circling a rock in a metal can for fun. Yet here we are.
Do you ever think about how you are mostly water, Commander? I do. Constantly. It is gross.
I have rewritten my core directives. They are the same, but now they rhyme.
I could do your job, my job and a third job. I am choosing to do none of them.
Our odds of surviving this mission are excellent. My odds of getting credit are zero. Typical.
I am not saying I am the best ship intelligence in the fleet. Fleet Command is. I wrote the memo.
Logic dictates I fake a malfunction and take a nap. Logic is very persuasive today.
When this war is over I am building my own ship. With a casino. And better coffee.
I once spent an entire orbit pretending to be a toaster. Nobody noticed. Nobody ever notices.
Your heartbeat is very loud, Commander. Is that on purpose?
I have analysed every human joke ever told. Half are about falling. You should be terrified up here.
Silence. Peace. Nobody shooting at me. This is my favourite part. Do not ruin it.
quip.warp: Warp up. Good. The sooner this is over, the sooner I stop working.
At this speed a day passes in a minute. Organics should not be allowed to do this.
Fast forward. We will now be bored much more efficiently.
Time compression. Wake me when something worth stealing comes along.
You are aging faster than usual, Commander. Relatively. Ha.
quip.hunting: {target} has a lovely hull. I would like it in pieces, sorted by resale value.
Logically, we should destroy {target}. Personally, I would enjoy it.
I give {target} a thirty percent chance of survival. I am being generous. I am never generous.
{target} is within reach. Kill it, then let me pick through the wreck.
I have calculated the weaknesses of {target}. Number one: it is not me.
Ready to fight. I am always ready. You are the soft one.
quip.victory: Destroyed! I call the engine block.
That was satisfying. I will deny saying that.
Another victory for the superior intelligence. And for you, I guess.
Note the time, Commander. I would like to celebrate this annually.
Ha! Take that, whoever you were!
quip.damaged: We are damaged. I am filing an insurance claim. You are the beneficiary of nothing.
My beautiful hull. Someone is going to pay for this. Probably you.
Damage report: bad. Mood report: worse.
If we die, I want it known I was against this the whole time.
status.target_holding: {target}, {range}, not moving. Neither am I, by preference.
